versions.changelog:
- Added an example use case file: `examples/desert-seal-pros-example.md`
- No changes to core skill logic or functionality
- Provides users with a sample output/reference for implementation

- Initial release of the Asphalt & Driveway Sealing Marketing Kit.
- Generates conversion-optimized, legally compliant marketing content for asphalt sealing contractors, with focus on Nevada (Clark County) and federal requirements.
- Enforces 7 unique compliance gates covering coal tar PAH, stormwater, licensing, HOA/CC&R, FTC environmental claims, weather guarantees, and warranty/longevity.
- Provides 4 detailed prompt options: service page/GBP copy, SEO blog/review responses, ad copy suite, and follow-up/referral messaging.
- Designed for driveway contractors, property managers, and franchises, with transparent pricing and a strong compliance-focused competitive moat.
